segments: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

entries.title: Genesis 8:4

entries.title: Genesis 8:8
segments: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

entries.title: Genesis 8:9
segments: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters [were] on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark. {pulled...: Heb. caused her to come}

entries.title: Genesis 8:10
segments: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

entries.title: Genesis 8:11
segments: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth [was] an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 8:12
segments: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

segments: ¶And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first [month], the first [day] of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

entries.title: Genesis 8:14
segments: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

entries.title: Genesis 8:15
segments: ¶And God spake unto Noah, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 8:16
segments: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

entries.title: Genesis 8:17
segments: Bring forth with thee every living thing that [is] with thee, of all flesh, [both] of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
